corpus.note: Line numbers are valid only for this commit. Clone with --depth 1 and check out this sha before scoring. The source is NOT committed: it is third-party code, and the provenance rule keeps it out of the repository.
corpus.include_note: **/*.py INCLUDING the test suite. Source-only would be 2,452 (pytest) and 2,652 (pydantic) chunks, far short of the ~10,000 this corpus exists to provide. Including every readable suffix would reach 9,653 / 13,377 but ~25-30% of those chunks are RST and Markdown, which would make a corpus counted as Python mostly not Python. `**/*.py` with tests is both 100% Python and at the target scale, and it is what our own walker would really store from this repository. ALSO excludes tests/mypy/outputs/**. Those are machine-written COPIES of tests/mypy/modules/ re-checked under each mypy config, so the same chunk appears up to 10 times - 694 of 10,470 chunks (6.6%) were duplicates. The modules/ originals are kept; only the generated copies are dropped.

fields.query: the question, as a developer would ask it
fields.file: the file holding the answer, spelled as Chunk.source spells it

fields.wording: named if it shares ordinary words with the answer, paraphrase if it deliberately avoids them
